sloka: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय देवानां रघुनन्दनः ।आरुरोह विमानं तं पुष्पकं हेमभूषितम् ।। ७.७६.१९ ॥
transliteration: sa tatheti pratijñāya devānāṁ raghunandanaḥ ।āruroha vimānaṁ taṁ puṣpakaṁ hemabhūṣitam ।। 7.76.19 ॥

translations.english: Having thus agreed to the words of the gods, Rama, the delight of the Raghus, ascended that Pushpaka aerial chariot, which was adorned with gold.
